title: Hearty Flaky Moroccan Cobnuts Tagine
description: A light and flaky Moroccan dish featuring cobnuts, with a focus on umami flavors and pescatarian-friendly ingredients. This recipe is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, sea salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped cobnuts and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the prawns and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 5 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Traditionally, tagine is cooked in a clay pot with a conical lid, but a skillet will work in its place.
Be sure to adjust the cooking time based on the size of your prawns.
